auth.signInLead: Ku soo dhowow mar kale buuggaaga glaze-ka.
auth.keepLead: Hayso wax kasta oo aad ku samaysay magaca {name}: ku dar iimaylkaaga iyo furo sir. Wuxuu sii ahaanayaa bilaash.

auth.trialNote: Akoon ma haysataa? Markaad gasho, wixii aad ku samaysay magaca {name} ayaa lagu darayaa. Cusub ma tahay? <signup>Samee akoon</signup> si aad u haysato.
auth.privacy: Iimaylkaaga iyo waxaad kaydiso waxaa loo isticmaalaa oo kaliya si akoonkaaga loo shaqeeyo, waxaana lagu kaydiyaa Amazon Web Services ee Maraykanka. <privacy>Sida Glazecalc u maareeyo xogtaada</privacy>
auth.terms: Markaad akoon samayso, waxaad oggolaanaysaa <terms>Shuruudaha isticmaalka</terms>.
auth.dataNotice: Glazecalc waa mashruuc bilaash ah oo il furan, akoonnadana waxaa lagu hayaa server-yo ku yaal Maraykanka. Waxaad akhrin kartaa hagayaasha oo tijaabin kartaa xisaabiyaha akoon la'aan, ama shaqaysiin kartaa nuqulkaaga. In aad halkan akoon ka samayso waa go'aankaaga, mashruuciina mas'uuliyad kama qaado. <where>Halka akoonkaaga lagu hayo, iyo doorashadaada</where>
auth.forgot: Ma ilowday furaha sirta? Dib u deji
auth.newHere: Cusub ma tahay? <signup>Samee akoon bilaash ah</signup>
auth.passkeyHint: Passkey wuxuu isticmaalaa faraha, wejiga ama qufulka shaashadda, halkii furo sir. Mid ku dar bogga akoonkaaga.

secondStep.codeFormat: Geli koodhka {digits} god ah ee app-ka xaqiijinta.
secondStep.recoveryMissing: Geli mid ka mid ah koodhadhkaaga soo-celinta.
secondStep.noPasskeysHere: Browser-kan ma isticmaali karo passkey. Isticmaal hab kale oo hoose, ama ka gal qalab awood u leh.

mfa.heading: Galitaanka laba-tallaabo
mfa.intro: Weydii tallaabo labaad markaad gasho, furaha sirta ka sokow: koodh ka yimid app-ka xaqiijinta, ama passkey. Markaas qof ogaada furaha sirtaada weli ma geli karo.
mfa.loadFailed: Galitaankaaga laba-tallaabo lama soo rari karin. Fadlan dib u soo rar bogga.
mfa.onText: Waxaad ku gashaa furaha sirtaada iyo tallaabo labaad, ama passkey kaliya.
mfa.offText: Si aad u shido, deji app xaqiijin ama ku dar passkey.
mfa.confirmEmailFirst: Marka hore xaqiiji iimaylkaaga, kor. Waxaan u isticmaalnaa inaan kuugu sheegno isbeddellada habka aad u gasho, iyo inaan ku caawinno haddii aad lumiso tallaabadaada labaad.
mfa.appText: App ku jira taleefankaaga ama maareeyaha furayaasha sirta ayaa muujiya koodh cusub 30 ilbiriqsi kasta, si aad u geliso markaad gasho.
mfa.passkeysText: Passkey wuxuu kugu geliyaa faraha, wejiga ama qufulka shaashadda, qalabkan ama taleefankaaga. Wuxuu noqon karaa tallaabadaada labaad, ama kaligiis ku gelin karaa, furaha sirta la'aan.
mfa.noPasskeysHere: Browser-kani ma samayn karo, mana isticmaali karo passkey. Isku day browser ama qalab kale.
mfa.name: Magaca passkey-ga
mfa.nameHint: Si aad u kala garato passkey-yadaada, sida “Laptop” ama “Taleefan”.
mfa.nameCheck: Sii passkey-ga magac 1 ilaa {most} xaraf ah.
mfa.passkeyLimit: Waxaad haysataa {most} passkey, inta ugu badan ee akoon yeelan karo. Mid ka saar si aad mid kale ugu darto.

mfa.codesLow: Dhawaan samee koodhadh cusub. Haddii ay dhammaadaan oo aad lumiso app-kaaga iyo passkey-yadaada, ma geli kartid.
mfa.offWhat: Galitaanka laba-tallaabo wuu shidnaanayaa inta aad haysato app xaqiijin ama passkey. Ka saarista kan ugu dambeeya ayaa damisa, kadibna:
mfa.offPassword: Galitaanku wuxuu u baahan yahay furaha sirta oo kaliya, sidaas darteed qof kasta oo ogaada wuu geli karaa.
mfa.offSignOut: Qalab kasta oo kale oo akoonkaaga ku jira waa laga saarayaa. Kan wuu ku jirayaa.
mfa.offEmail: Waxaan kuu soo iimayl garaynaa in la damiyay.
mfa.offRemoveApp: Dami galitaanka laba-tallaabo (wuxuu ka saarayaa app-ka)
mfa.offRemoveAppFirst: Ka saar app-ka, si aad u bilowdo damintiisa

export.heading: Soo deji xogtayda
export.text: Kaydi nuqul wax kasta oo akoonkaagu hayo hal fayl ahaan: faahfaahintaada, dejinta, walxaha aad haysato, habab, walxo, walxaha lagu daro, qoraallo, diiwaanka gubidda, talooyin iyo qashinka. Kuma jiro furaha sirtaada. Faylka ku hay meel gaar ah, maxaa yeelay wuxuu hayaa wax kasta oo aad kaydisay.
export.csvText: Ama kaydi xaashi (spreadsheet) oo ah hababkaaga oo kaliya ama walxahaaga oo kaliya, si aad ugu furto Excel, Numbers ama Sheets.

lead.help: Rasaasta (Pb) waa sun haddii la neefsado ama la liqo, waxayna jirka ku urursantaa, glaze rasaas leh wuxuu ku sii deyn karaa cuntada iyo cabbitaanka; xisaabin ma sheegi karto in gabal la gubay sidaas sameeyo iyo in kale. Marka uu dansan yahay, hababka horay rasaas ugu jirtay weli sidoodii ayay u furmaan.
lead.warning: Rasaasta (Pb) u isticmaal frit ahaan oo kaliya, marnaba rasaas cas, cad ama jaale ah oo ceeriin ah ama litharge. Isku dar adigoo qoyan, marnaba ha buufin, xiro respirator, oo ku nadiifi biyo. Weelka glaze rasaas (Pb) leh ka fogee cuntada iyo cabbitaanka ilaa tijaabada shaybaarka ee biraha ka soo baxa (leach test) ee gabalka la gubay ay ku guulaysato.
